description: Somos un grupo de Magos que predican el Conocimiento y el Aprendizaje al igual del consumo de cafe y pan.
summary: A central website was developed with two subpages designed to generate the greatest interest and understanding among readers. One of these is an interactive website based on a solar system that behaves similarly to the real one and is structured like a video game to encourage greater reader interaction, all of which serves to spark greater curiosity and interest among the general public.
details: The primary focus was on creating websites, as they are the most accessible and essential medium today. There are essentially three websites: one for the presentation and two for disseminating information using different methodologies, since one is interactive through a solar system-based system and the other through a video game featuring multiple missions and quizzes on the knowledge learned. HTML was used to develop the websites, and JavaScript for the physics content. We hope to make an impact by encouraging people to interact with the information and topics of interest, moving beyond simply viewing static information and instead stimulating the imagination.
